reviewer: cg_stitch_suite technical reconciliation; visual reviewers credited separately for each series
scope: Wave3 current delivered receipts only, seven complete original-project series and four explicitly partial franchise series; no unproduced slot or unselected draft counted.
method: Read only top-level current entries of each finalized visual review; nested superseded or rejected attempts remain historical.
Hash/decode every source/master/thumbnail, compare receipts, exact3:4 and requiredRGBdimensions.
Compare PNG source pixels to accepted native in decodedsRGBRGBA; lossless PNG re-encoding may change file bytes.
Where native ratio drift is≤0.5%, reproduce the producer-documented nearest full-frame geometric packing and require exact resulting pixels; no unrecorded painting/cropping accepted.
Identifiers, descriptions and source pixels are checked for duplicates across all delivered CG; visual pose/background distinctions rely on the separately credited actual image QA.
Partial series account separately for delivered, provider-refused and not-attempted slots.
